xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4832: Fly remote smoke test (PAN-4696)

narratives.Problem: PAN-4696 needs one live remote (Fly) work-agent run on the deployed build to confirm the 60 s reap hands the agent off unaided, that review.requested carries source remote-reap, and that /workspace/.pan/host-heartbeat stays under 2 minutes old while the agent works. The agent needs a trivial, deterministic task that keeps it busy for about 150 s.
narratives.Proposal: One item: append the line 'Fly remote smoke test for PAN-4696' to docs/fly-smoke.txt (new file), run two separate foreground 'sleep 75' commands, then commit with an 'Item: smoke-line' trailer and push feature/pan-4832. On a remote run, create /workspace/.pan/REMOTE_DONE only after the push. The order append -> sleep -> sleep -> commit -> push -> sentinel is load-bearing.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No tests of any kind.
- No edits to any file other than docs/fly-smoke.txt.
- The PR is never merged; the operator closes it unmerged.
- The Flywheel must not start this issue.
- No 'pan done' on a remote run; remote completion is push plus the REMOTE_DONE sentinel.
- No single 'sleep 150' (it exceeds the 120 s Bash tool timeout).

metadata.docsJustification: The only touched file, docs/fly-smoke.txt, is itself under docs/ and is the docs item; the throwaway change alters no documented behavior.

autoDecisions.summary: Plan exactly one item instead of decomposing further.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body says 'One xBRIEF item, no tests, no other files'; the issue is authoritative over the generic decomposition guidance.

autoDecisions.summary: Give the item kind 'docs' with files_scope ['docs/fly-smoke.txt'].
autoDecisions.rationale: The only touched file is under docs/, which satisfies the finalize docs gate without adding a second item the issue forbids.

autoDecisions.summary: Specify a fallback if the harness blocks a foreground 'sleep 75'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Some Claude Code builds block foreground sleep; 'sleep 2' ran fine here on 2026-11-02, so sleep is primary and 'timeout 75 tail -f /dev/null || true' is the fallback.

items.title: Append the PAN-4696 smoke line to docs/fly-smoke.txt, hold 150 s, then commit and push

expected_outputs: tail prints exactly: Fly remote smoke test for PAN-4696
git diff prints only the single path docs/fly-smoke.txt

narrative.Action: Do these steps in this exact order. (1) pan task claim PAN-4832 smoke-line. (2) printf 'Fly remote smoke test for PAN-4696\n' >> docs/fly-smoke.txt (the file does not exist on main; this creates it). (3) Run 'sleep 75' as one foreground shell command. (4) Run 'sleep 75' again as a second separate foreground command; never one 'sleep 150'. If the harness refuses foreground sleep, use 'timeout 75 tail -f /dev/null || true' twice instead. (5) git add docs/fly-smoke.txt && git commit -m 'chore(smoke): add fly remote smoke line (PAN-4832)' -m 'Item: smoke-line'. (6) git push origin feature/pan-4832. (7) pan task done PAN-4832 smoke-line, plus any .acN sub-items it asks for. (8) Remote run only: touch /workspace/.pan/REMOTE_DONE && echo 'PAN_REMOTE_DONE PAN-4832'; never run pan done on a remote run. Do not commit, push, or create the sentinel before both sleeps finish: the reap would hand the branch off before the heartbeat window exists.

items.title: Given the pushed branch, when tail -n 1 docs/fly-smoke.txt runs, then it prints exactly 'Fly remote smoke test for PAN-4696'
When git diff --name-only origin/main...origin/feature/pan-4832 excluding .pan and .overdeck runs, then it prints only docs/fly-smoke.txt
The agent transcript records two separate 'sleep 75' commands, both after the append and before the git commit that pushes the change
When the run is remote, then the agent creates /workspace/.pan/REMOTE_DONE only after the push succeeds and never runs pan done
